pois.name: Beebe 1-5 black smokers
pois.note: Real GMRT terrain (Ryan et al. 2009; value read directly from this tile's grid): -4,987.9 m, within a few tens of metres of Wikipedia's published coordinate for the Beebe Hydrothermal Vent Field (18 32'48"N 81 43'6"W = 18.5467, -81.7183) and inside Connelly et al. (2012)'s published depth range for the field, 4,957-4,987 m. The field's five main endmember vents (Beebe 1-5) branch from the same sulfide mound here and are the source of the field's record 403-410 degC supercritical fluid measurements.

pois.name: Rimicaris hybisae swarm
pois.note: Real GMRT terrain, -4,979.2 m, ~35 m from the main vent POI, inside the same real vent complex where Nye et al. (2012) described Rimicaris hybisae swarming by the thousand around Beebe's chimneys. `reconstruction: true` because no published survey gives exact individual-shrimp or swarm-density coordinates to place -- the swarm's real presence at this vent field is sourced, its precise mapped position here is not.

pois.name: Western sulfide mound
pois.note: Real GMRT terrain, -4,957.1 m, about 1.4 km west of the main vent POI and within the field's published depth range. Webber et al. (2015) describe seven sulfide mounds spread across the field's western side; this point is a real-terrain candidate within that footprint, not a citation to one specific named mound.
